milano.title: Wagner Residence: triple-aspect period apartment
milano.description_short: Triple‑exposure residence in one of Wagner-Pagano’s most iconic buildings. Set in Wagner, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
Set within one of Milan's most beloved Liberty-era buildings on the Wagner-Pagano axis, this triple-aspect apartment offers a rare combination of light, proportion and provenance. From the moment you cross the marble entrance hall, the interplay of restored herringbone parquet, double doors and oversized casements signals a residence built to be lived in, not merely admired.

The reception runs the full breadth of the façade, with three full-height windows opening onto the tree-lined avenue. Two of Milan's quietest courtyards flank the bedrooms, ensuring serenity at any hour. The kitchen has been re-imagined as an open culinary studio, finished in honed travertine and brushed brass.

A signature of this floorplate is the south-facing study, currently configured as a private library but easily convertible into a fourth bedroom or formal dining room. Service areas, a separate laundry and a discreet guest cloakroom round off a layout that simply works.

The neighbourhood needs little introduction: Wagner's market, the Teatro Nazionale and the Pagano metro are all within a five-minute walk, while Parco Sempione and Brera lie a short tram ride away. Properties of this calibre, original, intact and ready for a sympathetic interior project, are increasingly rare.

Available to view by private appointment.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: Porta Venezia: Belle Époque apartment on the square
milano.description_short: Elegant period apartment overlooking a charming Milanese square, offering outstanding potential in a prime location. Set in Porta Venezia, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
Few squares capture the soul of Porta Venezia like the one this apartment overlooks. A working belvedere of Milan's Belle Époque, the piazza beneath these windows hosts a daily ballet of trams, cyclists and aperitivo-goers, seen here through the silvered glass of original Liberty-era windows.

Set on the second piano nobile, the apartment retains its cathedral ceilings, frescoed coving and pitch-pine parquet. Three reception rooms enfilade onto the square; behind, the family suite enjoys absolute silence and a generous double exposure onto an internal garden.

Restoration is invited rather than required. Services have been brought up to current standards; the architectural shell, including original carpentry and a marble fireplace in the principal salon, remains intact. The new owner will find an exceptional brief for a discreet interior intervention.

Porta Venezia is enjoying its renaissance: Eataly Smeraldo, Bar Basso and the Indro Montanelli gardens are all within walking distance, while the M1 metro at Porta Venezia delivers Duomo in four minutes flat.

A defining address for the buyer who values an honest, untouched canvas in one of Milan's most cinematic neighbourhoods.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: CityLife Skyline: designer penthouse with sunset terrace
milano.description_short: Triple‑aspect penthouse with a designer terrace and spectacular sunset views over the city’s skyline. Set in CityLife, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
Set on one of the highest floors of CityLife's flagship residence, this 206 m² penthouse offers the rarest of Milanese luxuries: silence above the city. Triple-aspect, with sliding glazing on every side, the apartment opens onto a designer terrace orientated west, prime real estate for the Alpine sunsets that make this skyline famous.

The main reception is configured around a sculptural fireplace and accommodates both formal dining and a sequence of seating zones. A separate eat-in kitchen, hand-finished in matt lacquer and Calacatta, opens onto its own service balcony.

The bedrooms are arranged in a private wing, the principal suite enjoying double walk-in dressing rooms and an en-suite bathroom clad in book-matched onyx. Two further bedrooms share a generous family bathroom finished in honed travertine.

Building amenities are commensurate with the address: 24-hour concierge, residents-only spa with indoor pool, fitness centre and direct access to the CityLife park. Three secure parking spaces and a large basement cellar are included.

A genuinely turnkey proposition for the international buyer who wants the city's most visible new architecture without sacrificing privacy.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: Brera Hideaway: new-build penthouse with twin terraces
milano.description_short: Newly built penthouse with a terrace in one of Milan’s most prestigious neighbourhoods. Set in Brera, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
A newly delivered penthouse on Via Solferino, this is Brera's most cinematic floorplate: 270 m² wrapping a south-facing reception, two terraces and a discreet panoramic roof garden accessed by a private internal staircase. The architect has paired oak floors with hand-troweled lime walls, lending the principal rooms a soft chiaroscuro that flatters morning and evening light alike.

Three principal bedrooms occupy the east wing, each with en-suite bathrooms in honed Bianco Carrara, walnut joinery and bespoke ironmongery. The kitchen, by Boffi, opens onto the larger terrace via four-metre-wide sliding doors. A guest WC, walk-in laundry and dedicated entry foyer complete the principal floor.

The roof terrace is the property's coup de théâtre: an outdoor lounge with a built-in cabana, planted with olive and rosemary, offering uninterrupted views from the Duomo to the Alps. An automated awning system and integrated lighting allow comfortable use eight months a year.

Two underground parking spaces, a concierge service and a cellar are included. Move-in ready.

For the buyer who wants Brera's cultural pull without the compromises of its historic stock, this is a rare, contemporary alternative.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: Duomo View: penthouse above Corso Vittorio Emanuele
milano.description_short: Fully renovated penthouse with a terrace and panoramic views stretching from the Duomo to Milan’s skyline. Set in Duomo, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
The hand of an experienced architect is visible in every detail of this 100 m² penthouse, set ten floors above Corso Vittorio Emanuele between San Babila and the Duomo. The brief was simple: a pied-à-terre that could entertain six guests without ever feeling tight, and a terrace that delivered the city's most coveted view.

The reception room sits beneath a four-metre lantern that draws light deep into the floorplate; the kitchen, integrated and minimal, hides behind a wall of brass-trimmed cabinetry. Two bedrooms, both en-suite, occupy the quiet rear of the apartment; one currently doubles as a media room with sound-isolated walls.

The wraparound terrace, fully waterproofed and finished in honed porphyry, frames the Madonnina at one of the only altitudes from which she appears unobstructed. Custom planters and an outdoor kitchen extend living onto the terrace for at least seven months of the year.

A turnkey acquisition: services include concierge, lift, and one large basement storage. Perfect for the international buyer seeking the city's quintessential view.

The most architecturally photogenic skyline in Milan, framed from your own dining table.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: Magenta Rooftop: quietly elegant apartment with sky
milano.description_short: Elegant apartment with a rooftop terrace in a peaceful Milanese setting. Set in Magenta, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
In a quiet pocket of Magenta moments from Sant'Ambrogio, this 108 m² apartment occupies the entire top floor of a discreet 1930s building and is crowned by a private rooftop terrace of 35 m². The current owners have lived here for over a decade; the apartment has been continuously refined rather than radically redesigned, lending it the soft patina of a real home.

The principal living room is bookended by two large windows and a working fireplace in pietra serena. The kitchen, sized for serious cooking, opens directly onto a small breakfast loggia. Two bedrooms and two recently refitted bathrooms complete the floor.

The rooftop is the magnetic feature: planted with bay, lavender and a small fig tree, it offers genuine outdoor living above the rooflines of Magenta. There is space for a dining table for eight, a daybed corner and a discreet outdoor shower.

A rare entry-point into one of Milan's most resolutely civilised neighbourhoods, and an excellent base for a buyer who wants peace, light and walkable access to the historic centre.

The kind of address that grows on you, slowly, year by year.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: San Babila crown: panoramic penthouse on the Corso
milano.description_short: Luxurious penthouse with a panoramic terrace overlooking Corso Vittorio Emanuele. Set in San Babila, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
The Corso Vittorio Emanuele address says it all: this 200 m² penthouse sits a single step from the Duomo, in one of the most established palazzi of San Babila. A full architectural renovation reset the apartment as a contemporary residence behind a strictly conserved façade, opening up the floor-plan around the panoramic terrace and the apartment's signature views.

The principal reception is double-aspect, framing the Cathedral spires through one set of casements and the green Quadrilatero gardens through the other. The kitchen, by Molteni, is integrated with a generous breakfast area; behind it, a quiet service kitchen handles formal entertaining.

Four bedrooms occupy a separate wing, the principal suite running the full depth of the floorplate with twin dressing rooms and an en-suite bathroom finished in book-matched Sahara Noir. The terrace, planted and irrigated, can host a dinner for sixteen with the Madonnina as decoration.

Two underground parking spaces and a large cellar are included.

A genuine trophy property for the connoisseur, and one of the few addresses in Milan where the city's history and its present-day vitality can be heard simultaneously.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: Garibaldi Heights: skyline penthouse at TEN Milano
milano.description_short: Panoramic penthouse within the prestigious TEN Milano Residential Complex. Set in Garibaldi, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
Within Garibaldi's TEN Milano, one of the most recognised mixed-use developments in the city, this 194 m² penthouse delivers the full spectrum of contemporary living. The apartment is laid out over a single sweeping floor with a 40 m² terrace facing the Garibaldi skyline and a private rooftop garden of similar size.

Interiors have been delivered by the developer to high specification: oak engineered floors, matt-lacquer joinery, Gaggenau kitchen, and bathrooms finished in honed travertine with rainfall showers. Three bedrooms, two of them en-suite, occupy the north flank; a fourth room currently serves as a media den.

TEN Milano residents enjoy a suite of amenities rarely matched in the city: 24-hour concierge, indoor pool, sauna and steam room, fitness centre, business lounge and on-site parking. The Porta Garibaldi station, Corso Como and the Bosco Verticale are all within a 300-metre radius.

Move-in ready and ideally suited to an international buyer seeking a fully serviced lock-up-and-leave residence in the city's most dynamic district.

For those who measure home in services as much as in square metres.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: CityLife Light: park-side apartment with terrace
milano.description_short: Bright apartment with a terrace within one of Milan’s most innovative residential developments. Set in CityLife, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
A bright 76 m² apartment within the CityLife park-side residences, this is a smartly compact home for the buyer who values lifestyle and amenity over raw square footage. The kitchen-living room is open and double-aspect, opening through three-metre sliders onto a planted 10 m² terrace overlooking the park.

The principal bedroom comes with a generous walk-in dressing room and an en-suite bathroom in Carrara. A second bedroom is bright and quiet; the family bathroom is finished in honed Botticino marble. Engineered oak floors run throughout, and the apartment is delivered with integrated home automation and air-conditioning.

CityLife's amenity package is the strongest in Milan: residents-only spa with pool, fitness centre, 24-hour concierge, gated and surveyed park access, and ample underground parking. The new Tre Torri metro station is a two-minute walk; San Babila is reachable in twelve minutes by tram.

A lifestyle acquisition aimed at international professionals, pied-à-terre buyers and rental investors targeting the corporate market.

The thinking person's entry-point into Milan's most amenity-led address.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

milano.title: Isola Sky: apartment beside the Vertical Forest
milano.description_short: Brand new apartment within one of Milan’s most innovative residential developments. Set in Isola, a defining address for contemporary Milanese living.
milano.description_long:
Set within a brand-new development moments from Stefano Boeri's Bosco Verticale, this 144 m² apartment captures the spirit of contemporary Milan with rare clarity. The principal façade, due south-east, looks directly onto the vertical forest; the kitchen-living room is open and proportioned to host comfortably, with five-metre sliders opening onto a 16 m² loggia.

Three bedrooms, one currently as a home office, occupy a private wing; the principal suite has a dressing room and en-suite bathroom finished in Italian travertine. A second family bathroom, walk-in laundry and dedicated entry foyer round out a floorplate designed for both daily life and entertaining.

The building offers concierge service, secure underground parking and a residents' lounge. Energy class A places it among the most sustainable new addresses in the centre, an increasingly important consideration for the international buyer.

Isola itself has matured into one of Milan's most balanced neighbourhoods: galleries, third-wave cafés, and the city's best Sunday market all coexist around tree-lined streets that retain their working-class personality.

A quietly confident proposition that aligns with the next generation of Milanese living.
milano.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.address_approx: Camí de Coanegra, Santa Maria del Camí
mallorca.title: Santa Maria Estate: renovated farmhouse with saltwater pool
mallorca.description_short: A beautifully renovated country home with a saltwater swimming pool and beautiful, mature gardens. Set in Santa Maria del Camí, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
In the gentle Tramuntana foothills above Santa Maria del Camí, this beautifully renovated country home occupies 3.36 acres of mature gardens, citrus and a small private olive grove. The shell of the original finca has been preserved with the integrity of a hand restoration: marés stone walls, hand-hewn beams and old tile floors all remain, sensitively married to a contemporary interior brief.

The principal living areas open through five-metre doors onto a covered loggia and the saltwater swimming pool, framed by century-old plane trees. The kitchen is the social heart of the house, anchored by a long pine table and a working fireplace, with direct access to a kitchen garden that supplies herbs and seasonal vegetables.

Four bedrooms occupy the main house, the principal suite with a beam-vaulted ceiling, a private terrace and views toward the Serra de Tramuntana. A separate stone outbuilding has been converted into a guest cottage with its own kitchen and bathroom, perfect for visiting family or staff.

Santa Maria is one of the most coveted of the island's interior villages, with its Saturday market, vineyards and quiet streets. The estate is fifteen minutes from Palma and twenty-five from the airport.

A quietly serious country property for the buyer who values authenticity over spectacle.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Deià Charm: a quietly perfect home in the village
mallorca.description_short: A charming home in the heart of Deià with beautiful gardens. Set in Deià, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
In the heart of Deià, the most romantic of all Mallorcan villages, this charming home sits behind a discreet stone façade on a quiet lane in the upper village. The interior follows the traditional pattern of the local houses, with cool tiled floors, beamed ceilings and small, painterly windows that frame the surrounding olive terraces and, beyond, a slice of Mediterranean blue.

The principal living room opens to a covered porch and a series of terraced gardens that climb gently up the slope. The kitchen has been refitted with hand-glazed local tiles and a marble counter; a working fireplace anchors the dining area. Three bedrooms and two bathrooms occupy the upper floors.

The gardens are the property's most distinctive feature: 0.86 acres of established Mediterranean planting, with stone walls, fruit trees and a small swimming pool tucked into the lower terrace. From the highest point, the views reach across the village to the Teix mountain and, on clear days, all the way to the coast.

A walkable life: the village square, the Hotel La Residencia, Cala Deià and the artist studios for which the village is famous are all within a few minutes' walk.

The kind of house Robert Graves would have approved of, sensitively cared for, never overbuilt, and quietly perfect.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Binissalem Finca: new-build with vineyard surrounds
mallorca.description_short: An exceptional newly-built finca, built to echo traditional architecture, set in a serene landscape. Set in Binissalem, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
Set within the wine country around Binissalem, this exceptional newly built finca was designed to echo the traditional architecture of the island, with marés stone walls, slate-coloured roof tiles and timber-framed openings. The interior is uncompromisingly contemporary: open-plan reception spaces, double-height ceilings, polished concrete floors and oak joinery throughout.

The principal living room flows into a covered porch and onto a 20-metre infinity pool, oriented to capture the long afternoon light over the vineyards. The kitchen, by an Italian maker, anchors a generous dining area; a separate scullery handles entertaining.

Five bedrooms, each with en-suite bathroom, are arranged across two wings. The principal suite occupies its own pavilion, with private terrace, dressing room and a sculptural en-suite bathroom finished in honed limestone.

The grounds include a kitchen garden, an open-sided pool house and a small olive grove. Energy class A.

Binissalem itself has emerged as one of the most sought-after corners of the island's interior, equidistant from Palma, the central villages and the northern coastline. A serious entertainment-scale property without the maintenance burden of a heritage building.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Port d'Andratx Trophy: waterfront estate on Cala Llamp
mallorca.description_short: A spectacular estate at inimitable Port Andratx, with superb sea views and outstanding outdoor entertaining spaces. Set in Port d'Andratx, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
Few properties in the Mediterranean are as immediately recognisable as this Port Andratx estate. Sited on 1.14 acres of land that drop directly to the sea above Cala Llamp, the house has been engineered around the panorama: every principal room and every terrace faces west, framing the harbour, the open sea and the silhouette of Sa Dragonera island.

The architecture is contemporary Mediterranean at its most confident: clean white planes, deep loggias and floor-to-ceiling glass orchestrated by one of the island's most respected studios. The principal reception is a single sweeping volume that opens onto an infinity pool the length of the property and a sequence of outdoor entertaining terraces that can comfortably host a hundred guests.

Six principal suites occupy a private wing, each with en-suite bathroom and sea views; a separate guest pavilion offers two further suites for visiting family. The lower level houses a spa with indoor pool, sauna and steam room, a fully equipped gym and a media room.

Service infrastructure is comprehensive: staff accommodation, a separate caretaker's house, garaging for six vehicles and direct access to the marina below for a private mooring. Smart-home automation throughout; full-property generator backup.

A genuinely trophy proposition for the international ultra-high-net-worth buyer.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Deià Waterfront: a vine-covered hideaway above the sea
mallorca.description_short: An exceptional waterfront home with incredible sea views, vine-covered terraces and total privacy. Set in Deià, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
On the wild northern coast above Deià, this exceptional waterfront home is one of the most private addresses on the island. The estate, accessed through a long gated drive, drops in vine-covered terraces to a small private cove, with the open Mediterranean as a permanent panorama.

The architecture is a sensitive interpretation of the local vernacular: rough-cut limestone walls, hand-finished plaster, hand-glazed local tiles, and timber elements salvaged from the original farm buildings. The principal living areas are arranged on a single floor that opens to a series of covered loggias and, beyond, to the gardens and pool.

Five bedrooms, all with en-suite bathrooms and direct sea views, occupy the main house. A separate guest pavilion houses a further two bedrooms and a self-contained kitchen, perfect for visiting family.

Beyond the pool, stone steps wind down through olive and almond groves to the private cove, where a small wooden dock allows safe swimming and the launching of a tender. The level of privacy is absolute.

For the buyer who values nature, light and silence above all, this is one of the rarest acquisitions on the European market.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Sóller Finca: charming home in the citrus valley
mallorca.description_short: A charming finca with beautiful Mediterranean gardens, a swimming pool and spectacular mountain views. Set in Sóller, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
In the green bowl of the Sóller valley, surrounded by orange and lemon groves and ringed by the Tramuntana mountains, this charming finca offers a softer, less ostentatious vision of Mallorcan country life. The shell is a traditional 19th-century stone building, sensitively restored over the past decade with respect for proportion and material.

The principal living room is anchored by a working fireplace and original beamed ceiling; the kitchen, recently refitted, retains its tiled stove alcove and opens onto a covered porch overlooking the gardens. Three bedrooms and two bathrooms occupy the upper floor.

The gardens are the soul of the property: a swimming pool framed by century-old citrus trees, a kitchen garden, an open-air dining terrace and small lawns that step down toward the valley floor. The mountain views, from every aspect, are simply spectacular.

Sóller itself is a quietly civilised town, with its weekly market, the historic wooden tram to the Port and a growing community of artists and small restaurants. Palma is a thirty-minute drive through the mountains.

A romantic, livable entry-point into one of the island's most beloved valleys.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.address_approx: Es Camí Vell, Santa Maria del Camí
mallorca.title: Santa Maria Heights: contemporary villa with Mallorcan soul
mallorca.description_short: Exceptional contemporary villa with timeless Mallorcan charm and stunning panoramic views. Set in Santa Maria del Camí, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
A confident contemporary villa with timeless Mallorcan charm, this exceptional property sits on an elevated plot above Santa Maria del Camí with stunning panoramic views across the central plain to the Tramuntana mountains.

The architecture marries the traditional planning of a Mallorcan country house, a central courtyard, deep loggias and thick stone walls, with the spatial generosity of contemporary design. Floor-to-ceiling glazing wraps the principal living areas; the kitchen, by Bulthaup, anchors a generous dining area.

Six bedrooms, each with en-suite bathroom, are arranged across the main house and a separate guest pavilion. The principal suite occupies a private wing with double dressing rooms, a private terrace and a sculptural en-suite bathroom.

The lower level houses a spa with indoor pool, sauna and steam room, a fully equipped gym and a tasting cellar for serious wine collectors. Staff quarters and garaging for four vehicles complete the property.

The grounds, planted to a contemporary brief that respects the surrounding agricultural landscape, include a 25-metre infinity pool, a kitchen garden and a small olive grove. Smart-home automation throughout. A trophy property for the buyer who wants both heritage spirit and modern scale.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Cala Deià: villa above the UNESCO cove
mallorca.description_short: A charming villa with incredible sea views in a beautiful, UNESCO-protected cove of Cala Deià. Set in Cala Deià, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
A charming villa with incredible sea views in the UNESCO-protected coastline of Cala Deià, this 247 m² property is the kind of place that captures buyers from the first glance. The house, built into the slope above the cove, is arranged across three levels with every principal room facing the open Mediterranean.

The principal living room features original beamed ceilings, a working fireplace and a wall of glazed doors that open onto a generous terrace. The kitchen, sensitively refitted with hand-glazed local tiles and marble counters, opens onto a separate breakfast porch.

Four bedrooms, two of them en-suite, occupy the upper levels. The principal suite enjoys a private terrace with a panoramic sea view and a beautifully finished en-suite bathroom in honed travertine.

The gardens drop in terraced steps toward the coastline, planted with century-old olive trees, lavender and rosemary. A short flight of stone steps connects the property to the public path that leads down to Cala Deià itself, the most romantic cove on the northern coast and home to the legendary Ca's Patro March restaurant.

The setting is the property's most defining feature, and one of the most protected on the island.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Port d'Andratx Finca: renovated villa with two guest houses
mallorca.description_short: A beautifully renovated Finca-style villa with sensational sea views, generous outdoor entertaining spaces, and two guest houses. Set in Port d'Andratx, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
A beautifully renovated finca-style villa above Port d'Andratx, this 605 m² property combines the rustic charm of traditional Mallorcan architecture with the proportions and amenities of a contemporary villa. The main house has been comprehensively reworked: marés stone walls, original beams and old tiles have been preserved and married to a modern interior brief in honed travertine, oak and brushed brass.

The principal reception opens onto a generous covered porch and a sequence of outdoor entertaining spaces, anchored by a 20-metre infinity pool that frames sensational sea views toward the harbour. Outdoor dining for twenty, a built-in barbecue and a covered lounge make this a serious entertainment property.

Five bedrooms occupy the main house, the principal suite running the full breadth of the upper floor with double dressing rooms, a private terrace and a stone-clad en-suite bathroom.

Two further guest houses, each with two bedrooms and a self-contained kitchen, sit discreetly within the grounds, perfect for visiting family or staff. Smart-home automation throughout; full air-conditioning.

A turnkey acquisition combining country-house warmth with contemporary scale, in one of the most desirable corners of the island.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

mallorca.title: Sóller Valley: a beautifully restored stone farmhouse
mallorca.description_short: A beautifully renovated stone farmhouse in the picturesque Soller Valley. Set in Sóller, one of the most coveted addresses on Mallorca.
mallorca.description_long:
A beautifully renovated stone farmhouse in the picturesque Sóller valley, this 240 m² property is set in a quiet corner of the bowl, surrounded by orange and lemon groves and ringed by the Tramuntana mountains. The shell of the original 19th-century building has been preserved with the integrity of a hand restoration: marés stone walls, hand-hewn beams and old tile floors all remain, sensitively married to a contemporary interior brief.

The principal living room opens through five-metre glazed doors onto a covered loggia and the swimming pool. The kitchen, anchored by a long pine table and a wood-burning oven, has direct access to a kitchen garden that supplies herbs and seasonal vegetables.

Four bedrooms occupy the main house, the principal suite with a beam-vaulted ceiling and a private terrace overlooking the mountains. A separate stone outbuilding has been converted into a guest cottage with its own kitchen and bathroom.

The grounds include a 12-metre swimming pool, mature citrus groves and a small olive grove. Mountain views from every aspect.

Sóller is one of the most romantically situated towns on the island, with its weekly market, historic wooden tram to the Port and a growing community of artists. Palma is a thirty-minute drive through the mountains.
mallorca.photos_source_note: Hero photo from Knight Frank CDN (listing source). Supplementary photos from Unsplash for editorial demo only; commission on-site photography before production.

london.title: Piccadilly View: three-bedroom flat above Green Park
london.description_short: This fantastic three bedroom flat overlooks the beautiful open spaces of Green Park and combines capacious living space with a superb location on one of London's most prestigious streets. Set in Mayfair, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
Three-bedroom flat overlooking the beautiful open spaces of Green Park, this Piccadilly residence combines capacious living spaces with one of London's most prestigious addresses. The principal reception is a triple-aspect room finished in honed limestone and original parquet, with three full-height windows framing the park.

The kitchen has been re-imagined as an open culinary studio in honed Calacatta and brushed brass, opening onto a generous dining area. Three bedrooms occupy a private wing; the principal suite enjoys a walk-in dressing room and an en-suite bathroom in book-matched marble.

Building services include a 24-hour concierge and porter, secure lift access and a separate service entrance. The address sits at the heart of historic Mayfair, moments from the Ritz, the Royal Academy and Berkeley Square.

A turnkey acquisition for the international buyer who wants Green Park as their borrowed view, and the cultural fabric of Piccadilly as their daily landscape.
london.photos_source_note: Hero photos from Rightmove CDN (listing source, high resolution). Supplementary photos from Unsplash where listing offered fewer than 5 images.

london.title: Balfour Place: seven-bedroom end-of-terrace townhouse
london.description_short: A grand double fronted townhouse in the heart of the Mayfair Village, Balfour House is arguably the best house in Mayfair. With beautiful proportioned accommodation, triple aspect windows to the south, east and west, a lift to every floor a… Set in Mayfair, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A magnificent seven-bedroom end-of-terrace house on one of Mayfair's most discreet streets, Balfour Place is the kind of address that rarely changes hands. The house, set behind a Grade II-listed façade, has been comprehensively reworked by one of London's most respected interior studios.

The ground floor offers a sequence of grand reception rooms enfilade: a double-aspect drawing room with original cornicing and marble fireplace, a formal dining room finished in lacquered silk, and a library with custom oak joinery. The kitchen, by a leading Italian maker, opens to a generous family room and a discreet garden patio.

Seven bedrooms are arranged across the upper floors, the principal suite occupying the entire piano nobile with twin dressing rooms, a private study and a sculptural en-suite bathroom finished in honed travertine.

The lower-ground level houses a cinema room, wine cellar, gym, spa with steam room and full staff accommodation. The level of specification, from the bespoke ironmongery to the integrated smart-home system, places this property in a category of its own.

london.title: Grosvenor Square: five-bedroom apartment on Mayfair's iconic square
london.description_short: A Distinguished Home on Historic Grosvenor Square Set in Mayfair, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A five-bedroom apartment on Grosvenor Square, one of the most historically significant addresses in London. The apartment occupies the principal floor of a meticulously restored building, with windows framing the central garden and the canopy of mature plane trees that defines the square.

The principal reception is a double-aspect drawing room of grand proportions, finished with original cornicing, a marble fireplace and a sequence of full-height windows. The library, panelled in oak, doubles as a private study. The kitchen is integrated and operated by a separate service kitchen for formal entertaining.

Five bedrooms, all with en-suite bathrooms, occupy a private wing. The principal suite runs the full breadth of the apartment, with twin dressing rooms and a generously proportioned bathroom in book-matched Sahara Noir.

Services include a 24-hour concierge, direct-lift access, secure underground parking and porter service. A trophy proposition for the international ultra-high-net-worth buyer.

london.address_approx: Holland Park Gate, Penthouse, 257 Kensington High St, London, W8
london.title: Holland Park Gate: penthouse with skyline reach
london.description_short: Exceptional duplex penthouse, 4 bed, 4 bath, study, 5,498 sq ft with a 2,117 sq ft wraparound terrace across the 6th & 7th floors. Iconic scale, views and world-class London living. Set in Kensington, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A four-bedroom penthouse at Holland Park Gate, the most ambitious new development in Kensington. The apartment occupies the upper floor of the principal building, with a wraparound terrace that frames open views toward Holland Park and the West End skyline.

The principal reception is a single sweeping volume with floor-to-ceiling glazing on three sides, finished in oak engineered floors and hand-troweled lime walls. The kitchen, by Boffi, anchors a generous dining area; a separate service kitchen handles entertaining.

Four bedrooms occupy a private wing, each with en-suite bathroom and views over the park or the gardens below. The principal suite enjoys twin dressing rooms and an en-suite bathroom finished in honed travertine.

The building offers one of London's most comprehensive amenity packages: 24-hour concierge, residents-only spa with indoor pool, sauna and steam room, fitness centre, cinema, business lounge and on-site parking. Energy class A — among the most sustainable new addresses in the city.

london.title: Gloucester Road: two-bedroom flat with embassy quarter calm
london.description_short: A beautifully presented two-bedroom apartment situated on the second floor of this stucco fronted building on Gloucester Road, moments from the exceptional amenities of South Kensington. The apartment offers thoughtfully configured accommod… Set in South Kensington, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A two-bedroom flat on Gloucester Road, in the quiet embassy quarter of South Kensington moments from the museums and Hyde Park. The apartment occupies the second floor of a sensitively restored period building, with full-height windows opening onto a tree-lined street.

The reception room is generously proportioned and double-aspect, with restored herringbone parquet, original cornicing and a working fireplace. The kitchen has been refitted with hand-glazed tiles and a marble counter, opening onto the dining area.

Two bedrooms and two bathrooms occupy the private wing, the principal suite with a walk-in dressing room and an en-suite bathroom in honed Carrara. A small study completes the floorplate.

The location is exceptional for a quiet, civilised lifestyle: the South Kensington museums, Hyde Park, Holland Park and the cafés of Bute Street are all within a short walk. Gloucester Road tube delivers the City in twelve minutes flat.

A rare entry-point into one of London's most resolutely refined neighbourhoods.

london.title: Cheyne Walk: riverside house on the Thames
london.description_short: A Remarkable Grade II Listed Townhouse on Cheyne Walk Set in Chelsea, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A magnificent eight-bedroom house on Cheyne Walk, the most historically charged stretch of the Thames in central London. The house, set behind a Grade II-listed façade, has been carefully restored with respect for its 18th-century proportions and original features.

The ground floor offers a sequence of grand reception rooms enfilade: a double drawing room with river views, original cornicing and marble fireplaces; a formal dining room with hand-painted Chinoiserie wallpaper; and a library panelled in oak. The kitchen opens to a family room and a small private garden.

Eight bedrooms occupy the upper floors, the principal suite running the full breadth of the piano nobile with twin dressing rooms, a private study and a sculptural en-suite bathroom in honed travertine.

The lower-ground level houses a wine cellar, cinema, gym and full staff accommodation. A garage and direct river access complete the proposition.

Cheyne Walk's roll-call of former residents reads like an alphabet of British cultural history; this is the kind of address that holds its own across generations.

london.title: Chepstow Villas: six-bedroom end-of-terrace
london.description_short: An exceptional corner house with twin west-facing bay window along one side, giving very well-planned and beautifully proportioned accommodation. Set in Notting Hill, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A magnificent six-bedroom end-of-terrace house on Chepstow Villas, one of the most cinematic streets in Notting Hill. The house, with its classic stucco façade and original sash windows, has been comprehensively renovated by a leading interior studio while respecting the integrity of its 1840s shell.

The ground floor offers a sequence of generous reception rooms: a double drawing room with original cornicing and marble fireplace, a formal dining room overlooking the garden, and a family kitchen by an Italian maker. Six bedrooms occupy the upper floors; the principal suite features twin dressing rooms and an en-suite bathroom finished in book-matched marble.

The garden, fully landscaped, includes a covered terrace, mature planting and direct access to a private mews garage at the rear. The lower-ground level houses a cinema, gym and full staff accommodation.

Notting Hill at its most quietly confident: Portobello Road, the Electric Cinema and the Ledbury are all within a short walk, while the open spaces of Holland Park lie at the southern end of the neighbourhood.

london.title: Whistler Square: townhouse at Chelsea Barracks
london.description_short: A Stunning freehold house of 13,067 square feet within the iconic Chelsea Barracks development. Set in Belgravia, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A seven-bedroom townhouse at Whistler Square, the most ambitious new residential development in central London. The house occupies a corner plot within the gated Chelsea Barracks site, with private garden, dedicated entrance and direct access to the development's residents-only amenity package.

The ground floor offers a sequence of grand reception rooms: a double-height drawing room finished in hand-troweled lime, a formal dining room with bespoke joinery, and a kitchen by a leading Italian maker. Seven bedrooms occupy the upper floors; the principal suite runs the full breadth of the piano nobile with twin dressing rooms and a sculptural en-suite bathroom.

The development offers one of London's most comprehensive amenity packages: 24-hour concierge, residents-only spa with indoor pool, sauna and steam room, fitness centre, cinema, business lounge, secure underground parking and porter service.

Whistler Square sits at the intersection of Belgravia, Chelsea and the river — one of the most strategic locations in central London.

london.title: Chester Square: six-bedroom house with garden access
london.description_short:
A brand newly refurbished family home spanning 5,976 sq ft.
6 bedrooms, 6 ensuite bathrooms, internal lift, designer kitchen, cinema room, gym, spa, a landscaped terrace with a garden kitchen. Set in Belgravia, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A magnificent six-bedroom house on Chester Square, one of the most discreet addresses in Belgravia. The house, set behind a Grade II-listed stucco façade, occupies five floors and benefits from direct access to the gated central garden, a privilege reserved for residents of the square.

The ground floor offers a sequence of grand reception rooms: a double drawing room with original cornicing and marble fireplace, a formal dining room finished in lacquered silk, and a kitchen by an Italian maker. Six bedrooms occupy the upper floors; the principal suite features twin dressing rooms and a sculptural en-suite bathroom in book-matched marble.

The lower-ground level houses a wine cellar, cinema, gym and full staff accommodation. A garage and private mews entrance complete the proposition.

Chester Square enjoys an extraordinary central location, within a short walk of Hyde Park, Buckingham Palace and the shops of Sloane Street. A trophy address that holds its own through generations.

london.title: The Bryanston: amenity-rich apartment by Hyde Park
london.description_short: An opportunity to own a property on the most important corner of Hyde Park. Located on the 11th floor, this spacious three-bedroom plus study apartment offers 2,923 sq ft of luxury living and boasts panoramic views overlooking Royal Hyde Pa… Set in Marylebone, a defining address in Prime Central London.
london.description_long:
A four-bedroom apartment at The Bryanston, the most ambitious new residential development in Marylebone. The apartment occupies a high floor of the principal building, with floor-to-ceiling glazing framing open views toward Hyde Park and the West End skyline.

The principal reception is a single sweeping volume finished in oak engineered floors and hand-troweled lime, with a four-metre-wide opening onto a generous private balcony. The kitchen, by an Italian maker, anchors a separate dining area.

Four bedrooms occupy a private wing, each with en-suite bathroom and park or skyline views. The principal suite enjoys twin dressing rooms and an en-suite bathroom finished in honed travertine.

The Bryanston offers one of London's most comprehensive amenity packages: 24-hour concierge, residents-only spa with indoor pool, sauna and steam room, fitness centre, cinema, business lounge and on-site parking.

The location is exceptional: Hyde Park lies at the doorstep, while Bond Street and Marylebone High Street are reachable within a short walk.
